book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: I always thank my God concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge—

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you—

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise. I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.”

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Hasn’t God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn’t know God, it was God’s good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Greeks,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God;

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world that he might put to shame the things that are strong.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that don’t exist, that he might bring to nothing the things that exist,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: that no flesh should boast before God.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are coming to nothing.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: But we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn’t have crucified the Lord of glory.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.”

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or straw,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: each man’s work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man’s work is.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: If any man’s work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Don’t you know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit lives in you?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants and stewards of God’s mysteries.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by a human court. Yes, I don’t even judge my own self.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don’t have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: I beg you therefore, be imitators of me.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every assembly.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but the power.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For God’s Kingdom is not in word, but in power.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father’s wife.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: You are arrogant, and didn’t mourn instead, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when you are gathered together with my spirit with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: you are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: My defense to those who examine me is this:

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Have we no right to eat and to drink?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: What soldier ever serves at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard, and doesn’t eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock, and doesn’t drink from the flock’s milk?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Do I speak these things according to the ways of men? Or doesn’t the law also say the same thing?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For it is written in the law of Moses, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain.” Is it for the oxen that God cares,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should partake of his hope.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: If we sowed to you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: If others partake of this right over you, don’t we yet more? Nevertheless we didn’t use this right, but we bear all things, that we may cause no hindrance to the Good News of Christ.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are profitable. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things build up.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor’s good.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.”

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: But if one of those who don’t believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: But if anyone says to you, “This was offered to idols,” don’t eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For “the earth is the Lord’s, with all its fullness.”

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For the body is not one member, but many.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: If they were all one member, where would the body be?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: But now they are many members, but one body.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God, for no one understands, but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but even more that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Even lifeless things that make a sound, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: There are, it may be, so many kinds of languages in the world, and none of them is without meaning.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: If then I don’t know the meaning of the language, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: What should I do? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn’t know what you say?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: However, in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, or has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: If any man speaks in another language, let there be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself and to God.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Let two or three of the prophets speak, and let the others discern.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn and all may be exhorted.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: for God is not a God of confusion but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as the law also says,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: if they desire to learn anything. “Let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a wife to be talking in the assembly.”

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: What!? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking with other languages.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Let all things be done decently and in order.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith also is in vain.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up if it is true that the dead are not raised.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Wake up righteously and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Let all that you do be done in love.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.

book_name: John’s First Letter
text: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.

book_name: John’s First Letter
text: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.

book_name: John’s First Letter
text: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.

book_name: John’s First Letter
text: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.

book_name: John’s First Letter
text: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.

book_name: John’s First Letter
text: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.

book_name: John’s First Letter
text: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

book_name: John’s First Letter
text: We love him, because he first loved us.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not say anything.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak—not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is witness),

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, God’s word, which also works in you who believe.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all men,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For you are our glory and our joy.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: But Timothy has just now come to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For what thanksgiving can we give again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: that each one of you know how to control his own body in sanctification and honor,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don’t know God,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman. Then they will in no way escape.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: But since we belong to the day, let’s be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: Brothers, pray for us.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians
text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ our hope,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes rather than God’s stewardship, which is in faith.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: But the goal of this command is love from a pure heart, a good conscience, and sincere faith,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned away to vain talking,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say nor about what they strongly affirm.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: But we know that the law is good if a person uses it lawfully,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous person, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: I commit this instruction to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which were given to you before, that by them you may wage the good warfare,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: holding faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan that they might be taught not to blaspheme.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety, not with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: but with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Let a woman learn in quietness with full submission.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: (for how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule his own house take care of God’s assembly?)

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have followed.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Honor widows who are widows indeed.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of God.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: For already some have turned away after Satan.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder except at the word of two or three witnesses.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Those who have believing masters, let them not despise them because they are brothers, but rather let them serve them, because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and doesn’t consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy, strife, insulting, evil suspicions,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy
text: which some profess, and thus have wandered from the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For we write no other things to you than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end—

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: as also you acknowledged us in part—that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: When I therefore planned this, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I plan, do I plan according to the flesh, that with me there should be the “Yes, yes” and the “No, no?”

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me, Silvanus, and Timothy—was not “Yes and no,” but in him is “Yes.”

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: who also sealed us and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that to spare you, I didn’t come to Corinth.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: We don’t control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are being saved and in those who perish:

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face, which was passing away,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: won’t service of the Spirit be with much more glory?

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face so that the children of Israel wouldn’t look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: So then death works in us, but life in you.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” We also believe, and therefore we also speak,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also through Jesus, and will present us with you.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: for we walk by faith, not by sight.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you while he told us of your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced still more.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For though I grieved you with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you grieve, though just for a while.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vindication! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: how in a severe ordeal of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their generosity.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But as you abound in everything—in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us—see that you also abound in this grace.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: I give advice in this: it is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
