text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: For each man will bear his own burden.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised, just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians
text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: don’t harden your hearts as in the rebellion, in the day of the trial in the wilderness,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: where your fathers tested me and tried me, and saw my deeds for forty years.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways.’

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: We see that they weren’t able to enter in because of unbelief.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Let’s fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest;” although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works;”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter into it, and they to whom the good news was preached before failed to enter in because of disobedience,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: he again defines a certain day, “today”, saying through David so long a time afterward (just as has been said), “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts.”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Let’s therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let’s press on to perfection—not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: This will we do, if God permits.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: and tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, “king of righteousness”, and then also “king of Salem”, which means “king of peace”,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth out of the best plunder.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment to take tithes from the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “The Lord swore and will not change his mind, ‘You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.’”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By so much, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For finding fault with them, he said, “Behold, the days are coming”, says the Lord, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they didn’t continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them,” says the Lord.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says the Lord: “I will put my laws into their mind; I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all will know me, from their least to their greatest.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: In that he says, “A new covenant”, he has made the first obsolete. But that which is becoming obsolete and grows aged is near to vanishing away.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Now indeed even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service and an earthly sanctuary.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lamp stand, the table, and the show bread, which is called the Holy Place.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: having a golden altar of incense and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which was a golden pot holding the manna, Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself and for the errors of the people.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: The Holy Spirit is indicating this, that the way into the Holy Place wasn’t yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: This is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the conscience, of making the worshiper perfect,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: being only (with foods and drinks and various washings) fleshly ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For a will is in force where there has been death, for it is never in force while he who made it lives.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: saying, “This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you.”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: He sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Or else wouldn’t they have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, “You didn’t desire sacrifice and offering, but you prepared a body for me.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come (in the scroll of the book it is written of me) to do your will, O God.’”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Previously saying, “Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn’t desire, neither had pleasure in them” (those which are offered according to the law),

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: then he has said, “Behold, I have come to do your will.” He takes away the first, that he may establish the second,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and offering often the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: “This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days,” says the Lord, “I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;” then he says,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: “In a very little while, he who comes will come and will not wait.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: But the righteous one will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For by this, the elders obtained approval.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his only born son,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled for seven days.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith Rahab the prostitute didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Grace be with you all. Amen.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,

book_name: The Letter from James
text: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;

book_name: The Letter from James
text: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

book_name: The Letter from James
text: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;

book_name: The Letter from James
text: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: They said therefore to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However, he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar!”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold, your son!”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty!”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished!” Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Therefore the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with him;

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: but when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have laid him!”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he didn’t enter in.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: For as yet they didn’t know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they have laid him.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you don’t want to go.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: This saying therefore went out among the brothers that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books that would be written.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus answered him, saying, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.’”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The devil said to him, “I will give you all this authority and their glory, for it has been delivered to me, and I give it to whomever I want.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: If you therefore will worship before me, it will all be yours.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus answered him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He led him to Jerusalem and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: for it is written, ‘He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.’”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus answering, said to him, “It has been said, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him until another time.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He began to tell them, “Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: All testified about him and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth; and they said, “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to them, “Doubtless you will tell me this proverb, ‘Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in your hometown.’”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said, “Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue as they heard these things.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He rose up from the synagogue and entered into Simon’s house. Simon’s mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him to help her.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Demons also came out of many, crying out and saying, “You are the Christ, the Son of God!” Rebuking them, he didn’t allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn’t go away from them.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But he said to them, “I must preach the good news of God’s Kingdom to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately the leprosy left him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He commanded him to tell no one, “But go your way and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: After these things he went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, “Follow me!”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus answered them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They said to him, “Why do John’s disciples often fast and pray, likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to them, “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He also told a parable to them. “No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled and the skins will be destroyed.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Now on the second Sabbath after the first, he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain and ate, rubbing them in their hands.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But some of the Pharisees said to them, “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus, answering them, said, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: how he entered into God’s house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Rise up and stand in the middle.” He arose and stood.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Then Jesus said to them, “I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Simon, whom he also named Peter; Andrew, his brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Matthew; Thomas; James the son of Alphaeus; Simon who was called the Zealot;

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He came down with them and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits; and they were being healed.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for God’s Kingdom is yours.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Blessed are you when men hate you, and when they exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man’s sake.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Woe, when men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He spoke a parable to them. “Can the blind guide the blind? Won’t they both fall into a pit?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Or how can you tell your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,’ when you yourself don’t see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit, nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words and does them, I will show you who he is like.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep and laid a foundation on the rock. When a flood arose, the stream broke against that house, and could not shake it, because it was founded on the rock.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But he who hears and doesn’t do, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream broke, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy for you to do this for him,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, “Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Now when he came near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only born son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her and said to her, “Don’t cry.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I tell you, arise!”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He who was dead sat up and began to speak. Then he gave him to his mother.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, “A great prophet has arisen among us!” and, “God has visited his people!”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea and in all the surrounding region.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The disciples of John told him about all these things.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When the men had come to him, they said, “John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, ‘Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?’”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When John’s messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed and live delicately are in kings’ courts.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: This is he of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in God’s Kingdom is greater than he.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s baptism.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee’s house and sat at the table.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of ointment.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” He said, “Teacher, say on.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Simon answered, “He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most.” He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But one to whom little is forgiven, loves little.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Soon afterwards, he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of God’s Kingdom. With him were the twelve,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out;

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod’s steward; Susanna; and many others who served them from their possessions.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Some seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Some fell amid the thorns, and the thorns grew with it and choked it.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Some fell into the good ground and grew and produced one hundred times as much fruit.” As he said these things, he called out, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear!”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Then his disciples asked him, “What does this parable mean?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of God’s Kingdom, but to the rest it is given in parables, that ‘seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Those along the road are those who hear; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Those on the rock are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; but these have no root. They believe for a while, then fall away in time of temptation.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: What fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life; and they bring no fruit to maturity.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and produce fruit with perseverance.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: For nothing is hidden that will not be revealed, nor anything secret that will not be known and come to light.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Be careful therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he thinks he has.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Some people told him, “Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But he answered them, “My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Then they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When Jesus stepped ashore, a certain man out of the city who had demons for a long time met him. He wore no clothes, and didn’t live in a house, but in the tombs.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, “What do I have to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don’t torment me!”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For the unclean spirit had often seized the man. He was kept under guard and bound with chains and fetters. Breaking the bonds apart, he was driven by the demon into the desert.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” He said, “Legion,” for many demons had entered into him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They begged him that he would not command them to go into the abyss.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Now there was there a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain, and they begged him that he would allow them to enter into those. Then he allowed them.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The demons came out of the man and entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled and told it in the city and in the country.
