book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus’ feet, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: All the people of the surrounding country of the Gadarenes asked him to depart from them, for they were very much afraid. Then he entered into the boat and returned.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But the man from whom the demons had gone out begged him that he might go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “Return to your house, and declare what great things God has done for you.” He went his way, proclaiming throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Behold, a man named Jairus came. He was a ruler of the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus’ feet and begged him to come into his house,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: for he had an only born daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as he went, the multitudes pressed against him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians and could not be healed by any,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: came behind him and touched the fringe of his cloak. Immediately the flow of her blood stopped.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus said, “Who touched me?” When all denied it, Peter and those with him said, “Master, the multitudes press and jostle you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But Jesus said, “Someone did touch me, for I perceived that power has gone out of me.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling; and falling down before him declared to him in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to her, “Daughter, cheer up. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: While he still spoke, one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house came, saying to him, “Your daughter is dead. Don’t trouble the Teacher.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, “Don’t be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When he came to the house, he didn’t allow anyone to enter in, except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and her mother.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: All were weeping and mourning her, but he said, “Don’t weep. She isn’t dead, but sleeping.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They were ridiculing him, knowing that she was dead.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But he put them all outside, and taking her by the hand, he called, saying, “Child, arise!”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately. He commanded that something be given to her to eat.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Her parents were amazed, but he commanded them to tell no one what had been done.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He sent them out to preach God’s Kingdom and to heal the sick.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey—no staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money. Don’t have two tunics each.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: As many as don’t receive you, when you depart from that city, shake off even the dust from your feet for a testimony against them.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They departed and went throughout the villages, preaching the Good News and healing everywhere.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Herod said, “I beheaded John, but who is this about whom I hear such things?” He sought to see him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them and withdrew apart to a desert region of a city called Bethsaida.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, spoke to them of God’s Kingdom, and he cured those who needed healing.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The day began to wear away; and the twelve came and said to him, “Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms and lodge and get food, for we are here in a deserted place.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They did so, and made them all sit down.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to the sky, he blessed them, broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They ate and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: As he was praying alone, the disciples were near him, and he asked them, “Who do the multitudes say that I am?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They answered, “‘John the Baptizer,’ but others say, ‘Elijah,’ and others, that one of the old prophets has risen again.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “The Christ of God.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But he warned them and commanded them to tell this to no one,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: saying, “The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake will save it.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed when he comes in his glory, and the glory of the Father, and of the holy angels.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here who will in no way taste of death until they see God’s Kingdom.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Behold, a man from the crowd called out, saying, “Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only born child.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams; and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn’t.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But they didn’t understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: An argument arose among them about which of them was the greatest.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus, perceiving the reasoning of their hearts, took a little child, and set him by his side,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: and said to them, “Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For whoever is least among you all, this one will be great.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow with us.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus said to him, “Don’t forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: and sent messengers before his face. They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They didn’t receive him, because he was traveling with his face set toward Jerusalem.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky and destroy them, just as Elijah did?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But he turned and rebuked them, “You don’t know of what kind of spirit you are.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: For the Son of Man didn’t come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them.” They went to another village.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to another, “Follow me!” But he said, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But Jesus said to him, “Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce God’s Kingdom.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Another also said, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place where he was about to come.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go from house to house.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Into whatever city you enter and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But into whatever city you enter and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: ‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: In that same hour, Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, gave them to the host, and said to him, ‘Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet and heard his word.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, “Lord, don’t you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Give us day by day our daily bread.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to them, “Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight and tell him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won’t give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But if I by God’s finger cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come to you.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his plunder.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “He who is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, ‘I will turn back to my house from which I came out.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Then he goes and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice and said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will also be to this generation.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in and sat at the table.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and God’s love. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said, “Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won’t even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he began to tell his disciples first of all, “Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But there is nothing covered up that will not be revealed, nor hidden that will not be known.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light. What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “I tell you, my friends, don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell you, fear him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins ? Not one of them is forgotten by God.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, the Son of Man will also confess before the angels of God;

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of God’s angels.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, don’t be anxious how or what you will answer or what you will say;

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: One of the multitude said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But he said to him, “Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to them, “Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man’s life doesn’t consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He spoke a parable to them, saying, “The ground of a certain rich man produced abundantly.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He reasoned within himself, saying, ‘What will I do, because I don’t have room to store my crops?’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said, ‘This is what I will do. I will pull down my barns, build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.”’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose will they be?’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: If then you aren’t able to do even the least things, why are you anxious about the rest?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field, which today exists and tomorrow is cast into the oven, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But seek God’s Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Sell what you have and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don’t grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn’t fail, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Be like men watching for their lord when he returns from the wedding feast, that when he comes and knocks, they may immediately open to him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Blessed are those servants whom the lord will find watching when he comes. Most certainly I tell you that he will dress himself, make them recline, and will come and serve them.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They will be blessed if he comes in the second or third watch and finds them so.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched and not allowed his house to be broken into.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don’t expect him.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The Lord said, “Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them their portion of food at the right times?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Truly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But if that servant says in his heart, ‘My lord delays his coming,’ and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink and to be drunken,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn’t expecting him and in an hour that he doesn’t know, and will cut him in two, and place his portion with the unfaithful.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: That servant who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given, of him will much be required; and to whom much was entrusted, of him more will be asked.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Do you think that I have come to give peace on the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: For from now on, there will be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They will be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it happens.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When a south wind blows, you say, ‘There will be a scorching heat,’ and it happens.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don’t interpret this time?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there until you have paid the very last penny. ”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus answered them, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them—do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it and found none.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down! Why does it waste the soil?’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He answered, ‘Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it and fertilize it.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over and could in no way straighten herself up.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When Jesus saw her, he called her and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight and glorified God.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath and lead him away to water?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed; and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said, “What is God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his own garden. It grew and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky live in its branches.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Again he said, “To what shall I compare God’s Kingdom?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When once the master of the house has risen up and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’ then he will answer and tell you, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s Kingdom, and yourselves being thrown outside.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’t be that a prophet would perish outside of Jerusalem.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He answered them, “Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They couldn’t answer him regarding these things.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “When you are invited by anyone to a wedding feast, don’t sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you, ‘Make room for this person.’ Then you would begin, with shame, to take the lowest place.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, ‘Friend, move up higher.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He also said to the one who had invited him, “When you make a dinner or a supper, don’t call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, “Blessed is he who will feast in God’s Kingdom!”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But he said to him, “A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited, ‘Come, for everything is ready now.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They all as one began to make excuses. “The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please have me excused.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I must go try them out. Please have me excused.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “Another said, ‘I have married a wife, and therefore I can’t come.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “The servant said, ‘Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “The lord said to the servant, ‘Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper. For many are called, but few are chosen. ’”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he can’t be my disciple.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross and come after me, can’t be my disciple.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation and isn’t able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: saying, ‘This man began to build and wasn’t able to finish.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Or what king, as he goes to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy and asks for conditions of peace.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: So therefore, whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can’t be my disciple.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “Salt is good, but if the salt becomes flat and tasteless, with what do you season it?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. It is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He told them this parable:

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep and lost one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness and go after the one that was lost, until he found it?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When he has found it, he carries it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “Or what woman, if she had ten drachma coins, if she lost one drachma coin, wouldn’t light a lamp, sweep the house, and seek diligently until she found it?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost!’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “The manager said within himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don’t have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from management, they may receive me into their houses.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said, ‘A hundred batos of oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’ He said, ‘A hundred cors of wheat.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of God’s Kingdom is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: A certain beggar, named Lazarus, was taken to his gate, full of sores,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Yes, even the dogs came and licked his sores.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died and was buried.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue! For I am in anguish in this flame.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way, bad things. But here he is now comforted and you are in anguish.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that no one may cross over from there to us.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “He said, ‘I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father’s house—

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: for I have five brothers—that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “He said to him, ‘If they don’t listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the dead.’”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They lifted up their voices, saying, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When he saw them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus answered, “Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this foreigner?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Then he said to him, “Get up, and go your way. Your faith has healed you.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Being asked by the Pharisees when God’s Kingdom would come, he answered them, “God’s Kingdom doesn’t come with observation;

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to the disciples, “The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away or follow after them,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of one part under the sky, shines to another part under the sky, so will the Son of Man be in his day.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: As it was in the days of Noah, even so it will also be in the days of the Son of Man.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They ate, they drank, they married, and they were given in marriage until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came and destroyed them all.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Likewise, even as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: In that day, he who will be on the housetop and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Remember Lot’s wife!

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. One will be taken and the other will be left.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken and the other will be left.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there the vultures will also be gathered together.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for God’s Kingdom’s sake,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He took the twelve aside and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He called ten servants of his and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, ‘Conduct business until I come.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “When he had come back again, having received the kingdom, he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The first came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “He said to him, ‘Well done, you good servant! Because you were found faithful with very little, you shall have authority over ten cities.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “The second came, saying, ‘Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “So he said to him, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Another came, saying, ‘Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you didn’t sow.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, taking up that which I didn’t lay down and reaping that which I didn’t sow.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Then why didn’t you deposit my money in the bank, and at my coming, I might have earned interest on it?’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina away from him and give it to him who has the ten minas.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “They said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: ‘For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Having said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: saying, “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He answered them, “I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When he came near, he saw the city and wept over it,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: For the days will come on you when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn’t know the time of your visitation.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He entered into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house is a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of robbers’!”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests, the scribes, and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He answered them, “I also will ask you one question. Tell me:

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He began to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him and sent him away empty.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him and threw him out.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The lord of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Then they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.” When they heard that, they said, “May that never be!”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But he looked at them and said, “Then what is this that is written, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the chief cornerstone’?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They asked him, “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife and raise up children for his brother.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Afterward the woman also died.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus said to them, “The children of this age marry and are given in marriage.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: For they can’t die any more, for they are like the angels and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, you speak well.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They didn’t dare to ask him any more questions.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is David’s son?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “As for these things which you see, the days will come in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Then he said to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: It will turn out as a testimony for you.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: And not a hair of your head will perish.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “By your endurance you will win your lives.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the middle of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath to this people.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree and all the trees.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was counted with the twelve.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He went away and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He consented and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They entered in, and didn’t find the Lord Jesus’ body.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: While they were greatly perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. The men said to them, “Why do you seek the living among the dead?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise again?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They remembered his words,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn’t believe them.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: While they talked and questioned together, Jesus himself came near, and went with them.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to them, “What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn’t know the things which have happened there in these days?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
