text: He said to them, “What things?” They said to him, “The things concerning Jesus the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Some of us went to the tomb and found it just like the women had said, but they didn’t see him.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to them, “Foolish people, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They came near to the village where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.” He went in to stay with them.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave it to them.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him; then he vanished out of their sight.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They said to one another, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He took them, and ate in front of them.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to them, “This is what I told you while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms concerning me must be fulfilled.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He said to them, “Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: You are witnesses of these things.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: Behold, I send out the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.”

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands and blessed them.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: While he blessed them, he withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven.

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: They worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,

book_name: The Good News According to Luke
text: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t worthy of me.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He who doesn’t take his cross and follow after me isn’t worthy of me.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He who seeks his life will lose it; and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. He who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When Jesus had finished directing his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and preach in their cities.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He said, “Come!” Peter stepped down from the boat and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: The disciples said to him, “Where could we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: They all ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Those who ate were four thousand men, in addition to women and children.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, “Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He was changed before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Peter answered and said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let’s make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Get up, and don’t be afraid.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him and saying,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But this kind doesn’t go out except by prayer and fasting.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, “Doesn’t your teacher pay the didrachma?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Therefore the children are exempt.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the middle of them

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When he had begun to settle, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But because he couldn’t pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: The servant therefore fell down and knelt before him, saying, ‘Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him and forgave him the debt.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “But that servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He would not, but went and cast him into prison until he should pay back that which was due.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was done.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Then his lord called him in and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors until he should pay all that was due to him.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don’t each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Pharisees came to him, testing him and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He answered, “Haven’t you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh’?

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a certificate of divorce and divorce her?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He said to them, “Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: His disciples said to him, “If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But he said to them, “Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven’s sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Then little children were brought to him that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He said to him, “Which ones?” Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder.’ ‘You shall not commit adultery.’ ‘You shall not steal.’ ‘You shall not offer false testimony.’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: ‘Honor your father and your mother.’ And, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But when the young man heard this, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus said to his disciples, “Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and whatever is right I will give you.’ So they went their way.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did likewise.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: About the eleventh hour he went out and found others standing idle. He said to them, ‘Why do you stand here all day idle?’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “They said to him, ‘Because no one has hired us.’ “He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and you will receive whatever is right.’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “When evening had come, the lord of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Call the laborers and pay them their wages, beginning from the last to the first.’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “When those who were hired at about the eleventh hour came, they each received a denarius.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise each received a denarius.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When they received it, they murmured against the master of the household,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: saying, ‘These last have spent one hour, and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat!’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong. Didn’t you agree with me for a denarius?

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Take that which is yours, and go your way. It is my desire to give to this last just as much as to you.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to mock, to scourge, and to crucify; and the third day he will be raised up.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He said to her, “What do you want?” She said to him, “Command that these, my two sons, may sit, one on your right hand and one on your left hand, in your Kingdom.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But Jesus answered, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?” They said to him, “We are able.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He said to them, “You will indeed drink my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with; but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give, but it is for whom it has been prepared by my Father.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But Jesus summoned them, and said, “You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: It shall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: As they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Behold, two blind men sitting by the road, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: The multitude rebuked them, telling them that they should be quiet, but they cried out even more, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus stood still and called them, and asked, “What do you want me to do for you?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: They told him, “Lord, that our eyes may be opened.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus entered into the temple of God and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He said to them, “It is written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a den of robbers!”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: The lame and the blind came to him in the temple, and he healed them.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, and camped there.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, “Let there be no fruit from you forever!” Immediately the fig tree withered away.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, “How did the fig tree immediately wither away?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith and don’t doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ it would be done.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, “By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus answered them, “I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?” They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the multitude, for all hold John as a prophet.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: They answered Jesus, and said, “We don’t know.” He also said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He answered, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he changed his mind, and went.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I’m going, sir,’ but he didn’t go.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Which of the two did the will of his father?” They said to him, “The first.” Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into God’s Kingdom before you.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn’t believe him; but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn’t even repent afterward, that you might believe him.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a wine press in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When the season for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the farmers to receive his fruit.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Again, he sent other servants more than the first; and they treated them the same way.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But the farmers, when they saw the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and seize his inheritance.’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard, then killed him.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: They told him, “He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers who will give him the fruit in its season.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus said to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Therefore I tell you, God’s Kingdom will be taken away from you and will be given to a nation producing its fruit.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but on whomever it will fall, it will scatter him as dust.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When they sought to seize him, they feared the multitudes, because they considered him to be a prophet.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus answered and spoke to them again in parables, saying,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a wedding feast for his son,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding feast, but they would not come.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Again he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the wedding feast!”’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise;

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: and the rest grabbed his servants, treated them shamefully, and killed them.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the wedding feast.’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Those servants went out into the highways and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. The wedding was filled with guests.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn’t have on wedding clothing,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: and he said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here not wearing wedding clothing?’ He was speechless.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: For many are called, but few chosen.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter whom you teach; for you aren’t partial to anyone.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Tell us therefore, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, “Why do you test me, you hypocrites?

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Show me the tax money.” They brought to him a denarius.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He asked them, “Whose is this image and inscription?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him and went away.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: On that day Sadducees (those who say that there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: After them all, the woman died.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But Jesus answered them, “You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like God’s angels in heaven.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: This is the first and great commandment.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: saying, “What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he?” They said to him, “Of David.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet’?

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses’ seat.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and don’t do.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But they do all their works to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad and enlarge the fringes of their garments,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi, Rabbi’ by men.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi’, for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you don’t enter in yourselves, neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna as yourselves.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: And, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obligated.’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it and by everything on it.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He who swears by the temple, swears by it and by him who has been living in it.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God and by him who sits on it.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones and of all uncleanness.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets and decorate the tombs of the righteous,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn’t have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna?

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Therefore, behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the sanctuary and the altar.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But he answered them, “You see all of these things, don’t you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus answered them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Then they will deliver you up to oppression and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s sake.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Many false prophets will arise and will lead many astray.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But he who endures to the end will be saved.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let the reader understand),

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out the things that are in his house.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But woe to those who are with child and to nursing mothers in those days!

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter nor on a Sabbath,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: for then there will be great suffering, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever will be.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Unless those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved. But for the sake of the chosen ones, those days will be shortened.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘There!’ don’t believe it.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: For false christs and false prophets will arise, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Behold, I have told you beforehand.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “If therefore they tell you, ‘Behold, he is in the wilderness,’ don’t go out; or ‘Behold, he is in the inner rooms,’ don’t believe it.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: For as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: For wherever the carcass is, that is where the vultures gather together.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “But immediately after the suffering of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken;

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable: When its branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that he is near, even at the doors.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things are accomplished.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “But no one knows of that day and hour, not even the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: As the days of Noah were, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: and they didn’t know until the flood came and took them all away, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and one will be left.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and one will be left.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due season?

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn’t expect it and in an hour when he doesn’t know it,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: and will cut him in pieces and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When they saw him, they bowed down to him; but some doubted.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew, the brother of Simon, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He came and took her by the hand and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick and those who were possessed by demons.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: All the city was gathered together at the door.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Jesus said to them, “Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can’t fast.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: No one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples; and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came to him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press on him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him and cried, “You are the Son of God!”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He went up into the mountain and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: James the son of Zebedee; and John, the brother of James, (whom he called Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder);

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot;

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. Then he came into a house.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him; for they said, “He is insane.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He summoned them and said to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but has an end.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: “Most certainly I tell you, all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven, including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme;

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: —because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: For whoever does the will of God is my brother, my sister, and mother.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He said to them, “To you is given the mystery of God’s Kingdom, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: that ‘seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: The farmer sows the word.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He said to them, “Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn’t it put on a stand?

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: For there is nothing hidden except that it should be made known, neither was anything made secret but that it should come to light.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: If any man has ears to hear, let him hear.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He said to them, “Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you; and more will be given to you who hear.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: For whoever has, to him more will be given; and he who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He said, “God’s Kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’t know how.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: For the earth bears fruit by itself: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: It’s like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: yet when it is sown, grows up and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him up and asked him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased and there was a great calm.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They were greatly afraid and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and bowed down to him,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don’t torment me.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: For he said to him, “Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He asked him, “What is your name?” He said to him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: All the demons begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Those who fed the pigs fled, and told it in the city and in the country. The people came to see what it was that had happened.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They began to beg him to depart from their region.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you and how he had mercy on you.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name, came; and seeing him, he fell at his feet

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: and begged him much, saying, “My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: A certain woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came up behind him in the crowd and touched his clothes.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: For she said, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: His disciples said to him, “You see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He looked around to see her who had done this thing.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler’s house, saying, “Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid, only believe.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He allowed no one to follow him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He came to the synagogue ruler’s house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: When he had entered in, he said to them, “Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, “Talitha cumi!” which means, being interpreted, “Girl, I tell you, get up!”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get these things?” and, “What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” So they were offended at him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and healed them.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He said to them, “Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They went out and preached that people should repent.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick and healed them.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: For John had said to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”
