book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Herodias set herself against him and desired to kill him, but she couldn’t,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Then a convenient day came when Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, “Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: She went out and said to her mother, “What shall I ask?” She said, “The head of John the Baptizer.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: She came in immediately with haste to the king and requested, “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths and of his dinner guests, he didn’t wish to refuse her.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard and commanded to bring John’s head; and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse and laid it in a tomb.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He said to them, “Come away into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him and said, “This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give them something to eat?”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He took the five loaves and the two fish; and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They all ate and were filled.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick on their mats to where they heard he was.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Wherever he entered—into villages, or into cities, or into the country—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: (For the Pharisees and all the Jews don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.)

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: “For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men—the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He said to them, “Full well do you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: But you say, ‘If a man tells his father or his mother, “Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban,”’” that is to say, given to God,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: “then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: making void the word of God by your tradition which you have handed down. You do many things like this.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He called all the multitude to himself and said to them, “Hear me, all of you, and understand.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: There is nothing from outside of the man that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear!”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He said to them, “Are you also without understanding? Don’t you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can’t defile him,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: because it doesn’t go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, making all foods clean?”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He said, “That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: All these evil things come from within and defile the man.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: From there he arose and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house and didn’t want anyone to know it, but he couldn’t escape notice.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: For a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: But she answered him, “Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He said to her, “For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days and have nothing to eat.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They also had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of Dalmanutha.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven and testing him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He warned them, saying, “Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet or understand? Is your heart still hardened?

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Seven.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He looked up, and said, “I see men, but I see them like walking trees.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He sent him away to his house, saying, “Don’t enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him and began to rebuke him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: But he, turning around and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his life?

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see God’s Kingdom come with power.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He said to them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him, greeted him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He asked the scribes, “What are you asking them?”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: But they were silent, for they had disputed with one another on the way about who was the greatest.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He sat down and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He took a little child and set him in the middle of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: “Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me; and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him who sent me.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow us.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: But Jesus said, “Don’t forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name and be able quickly to speak evil of me.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: For whoever is not against us is on our side.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name because you are Christ’s, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: “Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if he were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched—

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: If your eye causes you to stumble, throw it out. It is better for you to enter into God’s Kingdom with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He answered, “What did Moses command you?”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They said, “Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: But Jesus said to them, “For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will join to his wife,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: If a woman herself divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands on them.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one—God.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not give false testimony,’ ‘Do not defraud,’ ‘Honor your father and mother.’”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He said to him, “Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Jesus looking at him loved him, and said to him, “One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me, taking up the cross.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: But his face fell at that saying, and he went away sorrowful, for he was one who had great possessions.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus answered again, “Children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out and say, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Jesus stood still and said, “Call him.” They called the blind man, saying to him, “Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man said to him, “Rabboni, that I may see again.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus on the way.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Jesus told it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He taught, saying to them, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers!”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: When evening came, he went out of the city.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Peter, remembering, said to him, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening, he shall have whatever he says.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your transgressions.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to him,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Jesus said to them, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: The baptism of John—was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we should say, ‘From heaven;’ he will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: If we should say, ‘From men’”—they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were amazed.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him!

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: When they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them as they walked, on their way into the country.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table; and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn’t believe those who had seen him after he had risen.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: I thank my God whenever I remember you,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Do all things without complaining and arguing,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians
text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Romans
text: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Romans
text: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Romans
text: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Romans
text: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Romans
text: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Romans
text: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Romans
text: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Romans
text: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to Titus
text: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—

book_name: Paul’s Letter to Titus
text: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to Titus
text: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;

book_name: Paul’s Letter to Titus
text: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to Titus
text: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to Titus
text: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to Titus
text: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to Titus
text: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”

book_name: Paul’s Letter to Titus
text: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to Titus
text: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to Titus
text: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to Titus
text: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to Titus
text: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to Titus
text: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to Titus
text: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to Titus
text: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to Titus
text: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to Titus
text: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to Titus
text: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to Titus
text: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to Titus
text: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to Titus
text: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.
